description: Amount text from the command line. imd-flop: `cap set <text>` (the same num() parses --per-call and --job-budget): accepted with the stored daily cap, or exit 2. spend-guard: guard.cap_arg(text): accepted float, or ArgumentTypeError (argparse exit 2). nan/inf are accepted by cap_arg and refused later by json_number (decision refused_local). Rule amount.min_cap (money stage 1): option cap is `cap set <text>`, --per-call is `cap set 1 --per-call <text>`, and --job-budget is a requester `run --job-budget <text>` (sent: paid calls made). A cap, per call cap or job budget below MIN_CAP (rules.json, 1e-6) is refused when it is parsed, exit 2.
